title: A Harmonised Building Material Intensity Database for Uncertainty-Aware Building Stock Analysis
description:
This release contains the harmonised global building material intensity (MI) database and companion probabilistic query-model artefacts described in the associated manuscript (Pei & Ang, Earth System Science Data, in review). It includes the integrated MI dataset (2,790 records spanning 32 countries), trained model artefacts, preprocessing pipeline, the deterministic train/validation/test split manifest, a record-level provenance crosswalk, and source code for inference and reproducible reuse.

The database is released as two separately licensed files within this archive: data/processed/Integrated_MI_database_add_Singapore.xlsx (2,739 records) and data/processed/carbenmats_subset_GPL3.csv (51 records sourced from Röck et al.'s CarbEnMats/GBDB dataset). This deposit's Zenodo license field is set to GPL-3.0-only (the more restrictive of the two, and therefore compliant for both files); the main database file is in fact released under CC BY 4.0 — see LICENSE (CC BY 4.0), LICENSE-GPL-3.0-carbenmats-subset.txt, and NOTICE-carbenmats-subset.txt in the archive for the exact per-file terms. Verbatim raw source-publisher files are not redistributed; a citation-only provenance crosswalk (data/processed/provenance_crosswalk/) preserves record-level traceability to all five source datasets without redistributing their compiled tables.
notes: See README.md for the per-file licence breakdown and data dictionary.
